products.title: Color Axia Chandelier
products.tagline: The Color Axia Globe Chandelier is a linear statement light fixture that offers a midcentury nod to contemporary lighting design.
products.body_html:
The Color Axia Globe Chandelier is a linear statement light fixture that offers a midcentury nod to contemporary lighting design. The design combines sharp CNC-machined edges with high-end aluminum and brass parts. The result is a linear showstopper that can be personalized by color and finish in the form of a stunning horizontal silhouette.

This chandelier features 6-inch hand-blown glass globes and is also available in a larger "Big Axia" version featuring 8-inch globes. Both sizes are designed proportionally to install above long dining tables and kitchen islands, but the designs are versatile enough to impress in a variety of situations.

products.title: Color Maxo Flush Mount 13"
products.tagline: The Color Maxo Flush Mount 13" was designed to create a statement, snug-to-the-ceiling silhouette perfect for high-end personalization.
products.body_html:
The Color Maxo Flush Mount 13" was designed to create a statement, snug-to-the-ceiling silhouette perfect for high-end personalization. The fixture combines colorful CNC-machined aluminum parts with metallic details to create an elevated lighting option.

The fixture features a unique, filleted-edge matte glass drum shade perfect for diffused general lighting. The fixture is built with an UNO thread, so if you ever decided you wanted another shade, then you can easily swap it out. It's a great lighting option in low foyers, low hallways, low closets, and above high swinging doors.

products.title: Color Cadbury Pendant 10"
products.tagline: Our Color Cadbury Pendant 10" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords.
products.body_html:
Our Color Cadbury Pendant 10" is the dome pendant born after we'd seen one too many tragically hung low-gauge dome pendants on crooked fabric cords.

The solution? Cover the cord with a solid brass rod, integrate a seamless cap atop each dome, and source aluminum domes thick enough that they don't sound like empty soda cans when you tap them. Alike all our lighting, this pendant is basically a masterclass in how to do lighting the right way. And with “Cadbury” meaning “strong fortress” in Celtic, this fixture is literally built on bold foundations.

Pop a pair above your kitchen island or flank your vanity for a look that says, “Yes, I have great taste. Thanks for noticing.”

products.title: Color Eureka Pendant
products.tagline: Eureka - you've found it!
products.body_html:
Eureka - you've found it! A fixture designed to help you discover (if you didn't know already) that you're a minimalist.

The Color Eureka Pendant is the light your space has been waiting for. Combining modern minimalist design with customizable style, this cute fixture creates that joyous “aha moment” every time you flip the switch. Handcrafted from high-quality materials, this ceiling pendant offers permanence that corded drop lights can only dream of. No flimsy wires here. Choose from 13 powder-coated color options to match your kitchen island countertops, dining room wallpaper, or inside a walk-in closet.

Whether you’re adding one for a focused glow or installing multiples for dramatic impact, Eureka was designed to help you discover your style... and your keys.

products.title: Color Legend 2 Sconce
products.tagline: They say legends are born, not made.
products.body_html:
They say legends are born, not made. We disagree. The Color Legend 2 Sconce is handcrafted right here in our Minneapolis studio — and it earned its name the old-fashioned way: by outselling everything else on the wall.

Two hand-blown opal glass globes sit on a CNC-machined aluminum body with solid brass hardware, delivering soft, flattering light that looks as good off as it does on. A perfect choice above a powder room mirror or in pairs along an expansive bathroom vanity scene. Choose from our variety of powder coat colors and 3 finishes to make it yours — and then tie your space together with some of our color-coordinated hardware.

All this Legend's waiting for is a Legend like you to give it a home.

products.tagline: If you want your space to tell your story, then why not make it a Legend?
products.body_html:
If you want your space to tell your story, then why not make it a Legend? The Color Legend 3 Sconce takes everything that made our Legend 2 a bestseller and just gives you more of it — an extra 7 inches for you size queens out there... and an extra ball.

Three hand-blown opal glass globes line a CNC-machined aluminum body with solid brass hardware, casting soft, even light in a form that looks as good off as it does on. Its longer profile was built for wide vanities, more expansive mirrors, and any bathroom scene ready for a colorful Dutton Brown moment. Choose from our variety of powder coat colors and 3 finishes to make it yours.

What type of Legend will your space tell about you?

products.title: Caliber Pull
products.tagline: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber.
products.body_html:
Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles.

Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. The pull mixes round parts with defined edges to deliver an impactful silhouette — its concentric ring arms couple with a dense, weighted feel atop cabinets, drawers, and pantries alike.

Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

products.title: Color Caliber Pull - Black
products.tagline: Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber.
products.body_html:
Meet the Caliber Pull — a solid brass cabinet pull destined for spaces and furniture that are themselves also high caliber. Or that will be, once you pair them with these dense, cylindrical baubles.

Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio by an artisan who is, you guessed it, high caliber. The pull mixes round parts with defined edges to deliver an impactful silhouette — its concentric ring arms couple with a dense, weighted feel atop cabinets, drawers, and pantries alike.

Not everything high caliber goes boom. Some things high caliber go "wow."

Meet the Persona Pull — the very first hardware design we ever made, born from a simple idea: spaces have personas. Some have more than one.

Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and powder-coated in one of our 14 signature colors, then finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio. The slim profile and three finish options mean it works as easily on a moody library cabinet as it does on a sunlit kitchen — line them across drawers, vanities, or pantries; mix finishes if your rooms have, well, range.

You don't need multiple personalities to use multiple Personas. But they are convenient for those who do.

products.tagline: Meet the Swift Knob — this T-shaped cabinet knob is part of our fastest-selling Swift collection.
products.body_html:
Meet the Swift Knob — this T-shaped cabinet knob is part of our fastest-selling Swift collection. Maybe there's something about the name. Or maybe it's just really cute?

Either way, folks love how this chunky yet defined CNC-machined aluminum rod (available in 14 powder coat colors) perches atop a solid brass arm in 3 finishes. What's more fun is that each one is finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio before being sent off to its perfect home — alongside our Swift Pulls on kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, or an heirloom dresser.

Honestly, we never really have to try to sell anyone on these. With the way they sell out, there's no more perfect name than Swift.

Each one is CNC-machined from solid brass and finished and assembled in our Minneapolis studio. The slim profile and three finish options mean it works as easily on a moody library cabinet as it does on a sunlit kitchen — line them across drawers, vanities, or pantries; mix finishes if your rooms have, well, range.

You don't need multiple personalities to use multiple Personas. But they are convenient for those who do.

products.title: Extension Rods
products.body_html:
Lead times for rods ordered alone vary. We stock brass, nickel, and black rods which ship within 1-2 days. For color rods, the lead time will depend upon our powder coating schedule which cycles every 3-4 weeks. Please contact us if you need the rods sooner.

Each rod is 1/2" diameter and contains 1/8 IPS threaded ends. The rods screw together seamlessly to form longer sections. To determine overall hanging height, add the length of the rods purchased to the maximum height shown on each fixture. For example, adding a 12" rod to fixture with an overall hanging height of 36" will make the fixture hang at 48".

If rods are purchased for more than one color item, please make a note on the cart page specifying which rods are for which fixtures, and we can package them together.

products.title: Hang-Straight Attachment
products.tagline: A hang-straight attachment is used to install a ceiling-mounted fixture with a rod on a sloped ceiling.
products.body_html:
A hang-straight attachment is used to install a ceiling-mounted fixture with a rod on a sloped ceiling. We offer two styles of hang-straight. Style 1 is designed for use with a rounded canopy, and Style 2 is for a flat canopy. Choose the fixture name and finish associated with the fixture you need a hang-straight for. If a fixture has two extension rods, it will require two hang-straights

Need a hang-straight after an order has shipped?
For Style 1, contact us as we'll need to create a custom order for you to purchase a canopy with a larger hole that fits the hang-straight. The standard canopy's hole is too small. For Style 2, the hang-straight screws into the existing canopy with no extra parts.

products.tagline: This non-refundable hang-straight and canopy are used to install on a sloped ceiling and are for purchase only if have already received an order for a Dutton Brown fixture.
products.body_html:
This non-refundable hang-straight and canopy are used to install on a sloped ceiling and are for purchase only if have already received an order for a Dutton Brown fixture. Do not purchase this kit before receiving your fixture. For a first order, you would only need to purchase the hang-straight add-on and we will include the proper canopy for no extra charge.

Please note this canopy will not include any UL labels or ratings labels. If you need your canopy to be labeled for inspections, we will only label the canopy if you contact us to tell us your order number and the product you need it for prior to shipping the kit. This kit is only available in brass, nickel, and black (no colors).

Last, if you purchase this kit as part of your first order, we will not contact you to reiterate what was stated above. We will still send what you need but will donate the extra money to happily plant trees in your honor.
